request.style: English, uplifting pop, clear male tenor vocal, piano, synth pads, electric guitar, punchy drums, anthemic chorus, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seventeen with a head full of dreams
Sheaves in the field bowing down to me
Wore my father's robe in the morning sun
Didn't see the anger I'd begun
Down in a dry pit under the sky
Twenty pieces of silver and a caravan goodbye

[Pre-Chorus]
A slave in a stranger's house
A prisoner in chains
But the LORD was with Joseph
Through the long and lonely days

[Chorus]
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good
Every pit and every prison
Brought me where I stood
Now I see it from the palace
What I never understood
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good

[Verse]
Pharaoh dreamed of cattle and of seven ears of grain
Seven years of plenty, then seven years of pain
They called me from the prison to stand before the throne
And all the land of Egypt was put under my hand alone

[Bridge]
Brothers came for bread and bowed down to the ground
Just like in the dream, the sheaves had all come round
I am Joseph, your brother
Come closer to me
Do not be distressed
God sent me ahead of you to preserve life

[Chorus]
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good
Every pit and every prison
Brought me where I stood
Now I see it from the palace
What I never understood
You intended evil against me
But God intended it for good
